items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Barry Martin. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, they all came in there.

ctx.x: Yeah, I stayed with Ambie. No, I stayed with Ambie about three years. We stayed down there. You was in there one night. Yeah. You and this drummer from Europe.
Yeah, they all came in there.
